Fantastic food & staff! WOW experience

3 contributions

Fantastic vegan food in Hue
Aug 2026 • Solo
Special vegan/vegetarian/chay restaurant in Hue. Everything so fresh and fantastic quality - from ingredients to presentation. Staff very kind. Recommend the veggie pho (very fragrant, tasty broth and lots of dipping sauces), the tofu curry, and the vegan pudding which is a taro ‘soup’ with coconut milk (delicious). They also do nice fresh juices and iced teas.
Read more
